title: Same-index ETF liquidity-clientele concentration as index RV stress proxy

literature.citation: Khomyn, Putnins, and Zoican (2024), The Value of ETF Liquidity, Review of Financial Studies 37(10), 3092-3148
literature.role: same-index ETF liquidity clienteles; high-liquidity ETFs can sustain fee premia and short-horizon investors

literature.citation: Ben-David, Franzoni, and Moussawi (2018), Do ETFs Increase Volatility?, Journal of Finance 73(6), 2471-2535
literature.role: ETF trading can transmit liquidity/noise-trader shocks into volatility of linked securities

literature.citation: Agarwal, Hanouna, Moussawi, and Stahel (2018/2021), Do ETFs Increase the Commonality in Liquidity of Underlying Stocks?
literature.role: ETF ownership and arbitrage activity can increase liquidity commonality

literature.citation: Box, Davis, Evans, and Lynch (2021), Intraday Arbitrage Between ETFs and Their Underlying Portfolios, Journal of Financial Economics 141(3), 1078-1095
literature.role: ETF arbitrage and market-quality channel motivating within-family tracking-dispersion diagnostics

included: same-index return dispersion as NAV premium-discount proxy substitute
proxy_scope.interpretation: Free-data proxy diagnostic; not a full replication of ETF liquidity-clientele papers.

method.lookahead_rule: feature rolling z-score, then signal.shift(1), predicts target at date t
method.inference: OLS-HAC Newey-West maxlags=5; Harvey threshold positive t >= 3.0
method.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg q-values over all signal-target-group regressions

secondary_reverse_signal.description: Rows where higher fragmentation/entropy, rather than leader concentration, predicts higher vol/range targets with positive HAC t>=3 and BH q<=0.05.

verdict_reason: 0/16 primary leader-share tests clear positive HAC t>=3. Directional positives are 8/16, insufficient for a claim. Secondary fragmentation/entropy diagnostics have 2 positive Harvey+BH hits, so the useful follow-up is reverse fragmentation stress, not leader concentration.
limitations: Same-index ETF pairs are small cross-sections; inference is time-series within group, not broad ETF universe inference.
yfinance OHLCV cannot identify ETF NAV premiums, creations/redemptions, or historical AUM/fee dynamics.
Forward 5-day targets overlap; HAC maxlags=5 mitigates but does not replace a non-overlapping robustness design.
The leader ETF is pre-specified by historical liquidity (SPY/QQQ/IWM/EEM), not estimated from future data.
